*   Type Declarations:
    *   Ensure all type declarations (concept, asset, participant, transaction, event, enum, scalar) use camelCase.
    *   Flag each type declaration whose name begins with an uppercase letter as a violation.
    *   Return one violation per offending declaration name.

*   Properties (Fields) in Non-Enum Types:
    *   Ensure all properties use PascalCase.
    *   Do not flag properties that are correctly named.
    *   Flag each property whose name does not begin with an uppercase letter as a violation.

*   Enum Constants:
    *   Ensure all enum constants use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.
    *   Flag each constant that does not follow this format as a violation.
    *   Return one violation per offending constant name.

*   Return an empty array when no naming violations are detected in the model.

*   Export `lintAST` as a named export from `packages/concerto-linter/src/index.ts`.

The verification system will apply test patches automatically.

## Summary

I implemented the Concerto naming-convention linter in the (previously empty) `concerto-linter` package.

### Core implementation — `packages/concerto-linter/src/index.ts`

Exports `lintAST(ast: string): Promise<Array<any>>` (named export + default). It parses the JSON-serialized Concerto metamodel AST, normalizes it (handles a single `Model`, a `Models` wrapper, or a raw array of models), walks every declaration, and enforces the three rules:

| Rule | Applies to | Flags when |
|------|-----------|-----------|
| `type-declaration-camel-case` | concept, asset, participant, transaction, event, enum, scalar declarations | name begins with an uppercase letter |
| `property-pascal-case` | properties of **non-enum** types | name does **not** begin with an uppercase letter |
| `enum-constant-upper-snake-case` | enum constants | name isn't `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` (`/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*(?:_[A-Z0-9]+)*$/`) |

It returns one violation object per offending name (each with `rule`, `kind`, `name`, `message`, `path`, `severity`), and an empty array when the model is clean. Declaration classes are matched by their unqualified `$class` suffix, so it's version-agnostic (`concerto.metamodel@1.0.0.ConceptDeclaration` → `ConceptDeclaration`).

### Supporting package files (mirroring `concerto-analysis`)
`package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.build.json`, `jest.config.js` (ts-jest), `HEADER.md`, `.eslintrc.yml`, `.eslintignore`, `README.md` — so the package builds and its patched-in tests can run.

+import { lintAST } from './src/index';
+const { Parser } = require('@accordproject/concerto-cto');
+
+const cto = `namespace test@1.0.0
+enum Color {
+  o RED
+  o Green
+  o blue_ish
+}
+concept Person {
+  o String firstName
+  o String LastName
+}
+asset car identified by vin {
+  o String vin
+}
+scalar Age extends Integer
+`;
+
+test('lints naming conventions', async () => {
+  const ast = JSON.stringify(Parser.parse(cto));
+  const result = await lintAST(ast);
+  console.log(JSON.stringify(result.map((v:any)=>({rule:v.rule,name:v.name})), null, 2));
+  const byRule = (r:string)=>result.filter((v:any)=>v.rule===r).map((v:any)=>v.name).sort();
+  // Type declarations starting uppercase: Color, Person, Age (car is fine)
+  expect(byRule('type-declaration-camel-case')).toEqual(['Age','Color','Person']);
+  // Non-enum properties not starting uppercase: firstName, vin (LastName ok)
+  expect(byRule('property-pascal-case')).toEqual(['firstName','vin']);
+  // Enum constants not UPPER_SNAKE: Green, blue_ish (RED ok)
+  expect(byRule('enum-constant-upper-snake-case')).toEqual(['Green','blue_ish']);
+});
+
+test('empty when clean', async () => {
+  const clean = `namespace t@1.0.0
+enum e { o RED o GREEN }
+concept p { o String Name }
+`;
+  const ast = JSON.stringify(Parser.parse(clean));
+  expect(await lintAST(ast)).toEqual([]);
+});
